q: The top layer of the Earth's crust in which plants grow their roots is ____. (P2)
explain: Soil provides mechanical root anchorage, moisture, and vital chemical nutrients to plants.
hint: Natural earthy ground layer supporting plants.

q: Which farm tool is used to carry water and gently sprinkle it onto young nursery seedlings? (P2)
explain: Watering cans feature a perforated rose head for gentle, non-destructive irrigation.

q: A tool with metal prongs used for gathering dried leaves, stones, and leveling seedbeds is a ____. (P2)
explain: Rakes collect garden debris and create smooth, even seedbeds ready for planting.
hint: Has metal prongs for gathering debris.

q: Animals that provide meat, wool, milk, or labour on a farm are called ____. (P2)
explain: Domesticated animals kept for agricultural production are known as livestock.

q: Crop classification: Yam is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 2).
explain: Yam is botanically classified as a tuber / root crop.

q: Crop classification: Cassava is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 2).
explain: Cassava is botanically classified as a tuber / root crop.

q: Crop classification: Rice is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 2).
explain: Rice is botanically classified as a cereal grain.

q: Crop classification: Millet is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 2).
explain: Millet is botanically classified as a cereal grain.

q: Crop classification: Sorghum (Guinea corn) is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 2).
explain: Sorghum (Guinea corn) is botanically classified as a cereal grain.

q: Crop classification: Cowpea (Beans) is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 2).
explain: Cowpea (Beans) is botanically classified as a legume.

q: Crop classification: Groundnut (Peanut) is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 2).
explain: Groundnut (Peanut) is botanically classified as a legume and oil crop.

q: Crop classification: Oil Palm is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 2).
explain: Oil Palm is botanically classified as a oil and cash crop.

q: Crop classification: Cotton is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 2).
options: fibre crop used for making textile clothing
explain: Cotton is botanically classified as a fibre crop used for making textile clothing.

q: Crop classification: Coffee is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 2).
explain: Coffee is botanically classified as a beverage crop.

q: Crop classification: Tea is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 2).
explain: Tea is botanically classified as a beverage crop.

q: Crop classification: Sugarcane is scientifically grouped as a ____ (Primary 2).
explain: Sugarcane is botanically classified as a sugar crop.

q: Animal husbandry: What major agricultural products do we obtain from Sheep? [P2]
explain: Sheep provide wool and mutton for human consumption and industrial use.

q: Animal husbandry: What major agricultural products do we obtain from Bees (Apiculture)? [P2]
explain: Bees (Apiculture) provide honey and beeswax for human consumption and industrial use.

q: Animal husbandry: What major agricultural products do we obtain from Silkworm? [P2]
explain: Silkworm provide silk fibre for textiles for human consumption and industrial use.

q: Animal husbandry: What major agricultural products do we obtain from Pigs (Swine)? [P2]
explain: Pigs (Swine) provide pork and bacon for human consumption and industrial use.

q: Animal husbandry: What major agricultural products do we obtain from Goats? [P2]
explain: Goats provide chevon meat, milk, and leather for human consumption and industrial use.
